package.name: mid360_pose_bridge
package.description:
Stream the robot pose to an STM32 over USB CDC at a fixed rate.
MID360 (Livox) + FAST-LIO odometry -> pose on `odom -> base_link` -> 15-byte frame `AA 55 | x f32 | y f32 | yaw f32 | sum8` -> STM32.
No map, no AMCL, no Nav2: the pose source is pure odometry, so it works as soon as the lidar runs. The transmitted values are relative to a movable origin that can be re-locked at runtime (the `refresh_origin` service also emits one (0,0,0) frame so the MCU re-zeros at the same instant).
